positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
(August 2019 - October 2020)
- Mentored by Pieter Abbeel and Lerrel Pinto
- worked on imitation learning, representation learning
- Publications: Visual Imitation Made Easy, Playful Interactions for Representation Learning

(August 2018 - May 2019)
-	Mentored by Pieter Abbeel and Ignasi Clavera
-      Worked on model-based reinforcement learning Cassie project
-	Train models and tune hyper-parameters. Created frontend visualization to analyze results.
-	Extended reinforcement learning capabilities to real-world complex 3D locomotion
-	Optimized Cassie robot’s stable running policy and built visualization setup to analyze results

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description:
- Worked with exec team to develop club goals and initiatives
- Hold weekly office hours/mock interviews/resume critiques for the CS community
- Restructured and organized big-little program for new candidates and members
- Handled logistics with exec team for end of semester events (banquet, elections, etc)

positions.title: Professional Development Chair
positions.description:
- Led professional development committee of candidates with co-chairs
- Hosted and organized club office hours and mock interviews
- Held professional development workshops (interview workshop, resume workshop, negotations, etc.)
- Compiled club-wide resume book to send to companies

positions.title: Web Dev Candidate
positions.description: Worked with a team to add features to the UPE website as part of initiation requirements

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Implemented and designed fully tested real-time document suggestion service for creative workflows. Built with Go and internal frameworks.
•	Designed and presented detailed technical design document to broader team. Set project timeline and milestones.
•	Prototyped finding nearest neighbors and profiled algorithms with pprof, worked with ML team to determine best use of similarity stack.
•	Improved similarity metric with new heuristic function and pair programmed frontend using Boq Web, Wiz, and JS/TS

company.name: UC Berkeley Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS)

positions.title: CS170: Efficient Algorithms and Intractable Problems Reader
positions.description:
- Graded problem sets
- Held weekly office hours, homework parties, and guerilla sections
- Created video walk-throughs for past final exam questions

positions.title: CS61A, CS61B: Tutor
positions.description:
Course Tutor: CS61A: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs
CSM Mentor: CS61B: Data Structures

positions.title: Academic Intern
positions.description:
• CS61B: Data Structures, CS 61A: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs.
• Helped students with concepts in Python for introductory CS course
• Guided students through labs, homework, as well as projects
• Assisted in office hours to clarify concepts  and answer questions in how to approach problems in CS courses

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented the flow and automation of the decommissioning process of App Engine out of a geographic location. This increased reliability and predictability of the process and decreased time spent.
- Co-authored a detailed technical design document and project managed implementation work. I identified a gap in requirements, then proposed and implemented a solution to make the process simplified.
- Achieved 85% fully tested automation of the entire process while leveraging and contributing to horizontal automation frameworks built with Python, multiple internal configuration languages, and protocol buffers. 
- Attended tech and leadership workshops at the Google We Are GWE (Google Women in Engineering) Summit and played in Google Orchestra

positions.title: Engineering Essentials Fellow
positions.description:
- Participated in a selective training program at Goldman Sachs in full stack development
- Developed stock visualization app with a team using technologies including React, RESTful services, Jackson, JavaScript
- Learned about the technologies and financial services at the firm

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Research and improve functionality of AutoWare software for autonomous car development

company.name: Model Predictive Control Lab, UC Berkeley

positions.title: Algorithm Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed quantitative trading algorithms for domestic and international equities in Python
•	Implemented key components of robo-advising system, i.e. client-side tax-loss harvesting and dividend reinvestment services

positions.title: Externship
positions.description:
• Contributed to building subscriber and publisher nodes using ROS
• Helped implement driver for LED light for robot using Python / C++

positions.title: INSIGHT Program Participant, Software Development
positions.description:
• Learned basics of OCAML to write Lumines game 
• Built an elementary trading bot in Python that implemented arbitrage, pennying, and other strategies to maximize profit

positions.description:
-Substitute teacher

positions.title: Co-Founder, Vice President
positions.description:
• Integrate art with STEM; led in exploring recent technological discoveries in robotics and technology
• Present and organize activities and events, i.e. Berkeley Robot Learning Lab Trip

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Taught Python to middle school girls
• Guided students through logical thinking and good coding practices
• Organized and facilitated ice-breakers and discussions
• Researched documentaries regarding Computer Science discoveries to present to students

volunteerExperiences.description:
District Council (Secretary): 
• Collaborate in bi­monthly in meetings with local Rotarians to host 4 district wide events
• Solve organizational problems and communicated with local area Interact Club
• Raised over $10,000 for One Million Lights: solar lights that replace dangerous kerosene lamps to enable children to study at night and adults to extend their workday

School chapter (Membership):
• Participated in Fall Leadership Conference; Salesian College Preparatory School, Benicia
• Organized fundraisers, i.e. Movie Night: “Guardians of the Galaxy,” for the Wheelchair Foundation
• Tracked members’ points, recruited new member
• Volunteered at local festivals and schools, i.e. Tassajara Hills Fall Carnival
